ex.en: His daughter is able to recite a lot of poems.
ex.zh: 他的女兒能背很多首詩。

ex.en: Have you ever read any Chinese poems?
ex.zh: 你讀過中國詩嗎？

ex.en: A portion of the proceeds will go to benefit children with disabilities.
ex.zh: 一部分收益將用於幫助身心障礙兒童。

ex.en: A large portion of the budget goes to marketing.
ex.zh: 預算中有很大一部分用在行銷上。

ex.en: He finished the steak, then ordered another portion.
ex.zh: 他吃完牛排，又點了一份。

ex.en: The portions are ginormous.
ex.zh: 這裡的份量超大。

ex.en: How did he make his living in such poverty?
ex.zh: 他在這麼貧困的情況下要怎麼維生？

ex.en: The president called on the people to unite in fighting poverty and disease.
ex.zh: 總統呼籲人民團結對抗貧窮與疾病。

ex.en: There is nowhere in the whole world without poverty.
ex.zh: 全世界沒有一個地方沒有貧窮。

ex.en: My uncle is possessed of great wealth.
ex.zh: 我叔叔擁有大量財富。

ex.en: She possesses excellent communication skills.
ex.zh: 她具備出色的溝通能力。

ex.en: Do you possess a valid driver's license?
ex.zh: 你有有效的駕照嗎？

ex.en: This is the village where the poet was born.
ex.zh: 這是那位詩人出生的村莊。

ex.en: He is not a poet but a novelist.
ex.zh: 他不是詩人，而是小說家。

ex.en: Many famous philosophers and poets come from Athens.
ex.zh: 很多有名的哲學家和詩人都來自雅典。

ex.en: It's been quite a while since I've written poetry.
ex.zh: 我已經好久沒寫詩了。

ex.en: They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
ex.zh: 他們稱喬叟為英詩之父。

ex.en: He prefers poetry to fiction.
ex.zh: 比起小說，他更喜歡詩。

ex.en: The ball is that boy's prized possession.
ex.zh: 這顆球是那個男孩最珍惜的寶貝。

ex.en: He lost all his possessions in the fire.
ex.zh: 他在火災中失去了所有財物。

ex.en: The Spanish team is great at keeping possession of the ball.
ex.zh: 西班牙隊很擅長控球。

ex.en: The documents are now in our possession.
ex.zh: 那些文件現在在我們手上。

ex.en: Because Tom didn't thoroughly clean the pots, Mary got dysentery.
ex.zh: 因為湯姆沒有把鍋子洗乾淨，瑪麗得了痢疾。

ex.en: Boil some water in a large pot.
ex.zh: 用大鍋子煮一些水。

ex.en: Do you offer coffee pots in different sizes?
ex.zh: 你們有不同尺寸的咖啡壺嗎？

ex.en: There is no sugar left in the pot.
ex.zh: 罐子裡沒有糖了。

ex.en: I'll make a pot of tea for everyone.
ex.zh: 我來幫大家泡一壺茶。

ex.en: She renewed the soil in the flower pot.
ex.zh: 她把花盆裡的土換新了。

ex.en: She planted some herbs in a small pot.
ex.zh: 她在小花盆裡種了一些香草。

ex.en: This mistake could potentially cost us millions.
ex.zh: 這個錯誤可能讓我們損失數百萬。

ex.en: The new market is potentially very profitable.
ex.zh: 這個新市場可能非常有利可圖。

ex.en: Smoking is potentially harmful to the people around you.
ex.zh: 吸菸可能危害你身邊的人。

ex.en: I am peeling the celery and the potatoes.
ex.zh: 我在削芹菜和馬鈴薯。

ex.en: I want to slice these potatoes into strips.
ex.zh: 我想把這些馬鈴薯切成絲。

ex.en: Potatoes are one of the most common foodstuffs.
ex.zh: 馬鈴薯是最常見的食材之一。

ex.en: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
ex.zh: 我不該把一整包洋芋片吃完的。

ex.en: Potato chips are my favorite snack.
ex.zh: 洋芋片是我最愛的零食。

ex.en: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.
ex.zh: 牆上掛著鮑伯的肖像畫。

ex.en: The king’s portrait was unveiled to great applause.
ex.zh: 國王的肖像揭幕時，現場響起熱烈掌聲。

ex.en: Please print the document in portrait orientation.
ex.zh: 請用直式列印這份文件。

ex.en: This photo looks better in portrait than landscape.
ex.zh: 這張照片直式比橫式好看。

ex.en: The aurora is a phenomenon characteristic of the polar regions.
ex.zh: 極光是極地特有的現象。

ex.en: Melting polar icecaps could also contribute to an increase in sea levels.
ex.zh: 極地冰帽融化也可能導致海平面上升。

ex.en: The two brothers have polar opposite personalities.
ex.zh: 這兩兄弟的個性截然相反。

ex.en: Their views on the issue are polar opposites.
ex.zh: 他們對這個議題的看法完全相反。

ex.en: The film's portrayal of office life is very realistic.
ex.zh: 這部電影對上班族生活的描繪非常寫實。

ex.en: Critics praised her portrayal of the queen.
ex.zh: 影評稱讚她對女王一角的詮釋。

ex.en: She is taking a postgraduate course in finance.
ex.zh: 她正在念金融研究所課程。

ex.en: The university offers many postgraduate programs.
ex.zh: 這所大學提供許多研究所課程。

ex.en: Most of the postgraduates work as teaching assistants.
ex.zh: 大部分研究生都在當助教。

ex.en: As a postgraduate, he spends most of his time in the lab.
ex.zh: 身為研究生，他大部分時間都待在實驗室。

ex.en: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.
ex.zh: 用本生燈加熱鉀，火焰會呈淡紫色。

ex.en: Bananas are a good source of potassium.
ex.zh: 香蕉是很好的鉀來源。

ex.en: The table is covered with powder.
ex.zh: 桌上滿是粉末。

ex.en: Mix the powder with warm water.
ex.zh: 把粉末和溫水混合。

ex.en: She powdered her face before going on stage.
ex.zh: 她上台前在臉上撲了粉。

ex.en: The baker powdered the cookies with sugar.
ex.zh: 麵包師傅在餅乾上撒了糖粉。

ex.en: I fully agree with your point of view.
ex.zh: 我完全贊成你的觀點。

ex.en: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
ex.zh: 在我看來，汽車弊大於利。

ex.en: I understood Tom's point of view.
ex.zh: 我理解湯姆的觀點。

ex.en: How large is the population of New York City?
ex.zh: 紐約市的人口有多少？

ex.en: The population has doubled in the last five years.
ex.zh: 過去五年人口增加了一倍。

ex.en: The population of the world will double before long.
ex.zh: 世界人口很快就會倍增。

ex.en: Only small populations of giraffes remain in this country.
ex.zh: 這個國家只剩下少數的長頸鹿族群。

ex.en: The tiger population is slowly increasing.
ex.zh: 老虎的數量正在慢慢增加。

ex.en: Our brand positioning focuses on quality, not low prices.
ex.zh: 我們的品牌定位著重品質，而非低價。

ex.en: The product failed because of poor positioning.
ex.zh: 這項產品因為定位不佳而失敗。

ex.en: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
ex.zh: 這項政策導致物價大幅上漲。

ex.en: In order to alleviate employment pressures, the nation has established a series of relevant policies.
ex.zh: 為了緩解就業壓力，國家已經制定了一系列相關政策。

ex.en: He had decided on a new policy.
ex.zh: 他已經決定了新的政策。

ex.en: Our return policy allows refunds within 30 days.
ex.zh: 我們的退貨規定是 30 天內可以退款。

ex.en: Company policy does not allow pets in the office.
ex.zh: 公司規定辦公室裡不能帶寵物。

ex.en: Read your insurance policy carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細閱讀你的保單。

ex.en: The policy covers fire and theft.
ex.zh: 這份保單涵蓋火災和竊盜。

ex.en: She added a short postscript to the letter.
ex.zh: 她在信末加了一段簡短附言。

ex.en: The postscript included the updated meeting time.
ex.zh: 附言裡補上了更新後的會議時間。

ex.en: The postmark shows that the letter was mailed yesterday.
ex.zh: 郵戳顯示這封信是昨天寄出的。

ex.en: Please check the postmark on the returned envelope.
ex.zh: 請查看退回信封上的郵戳。

ex.en: The shipment cleared customs at its first port of entry.
ex.zh: 這批貨在第一個入境口岸完成通關。

ex.en: The form asks you to name the port of entry.
ex.zh: 表格要求填寫入境口岸。

ex.en: The driver swerved to avoid a deep pothole.
ex.zh: 駕駛人為了閃避深坑而突然轉向。

ex.en: Residents reported several potholes after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後，居民通報了好幾個路面坑洞。

ex.en: The police got to the scene of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方抵達了事故現場。

ex.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查事故原因。

ex.en: The fire station is next to the police station.
ex.zh: 消防局在警察局的旁邊。

ex.en: Tom probably knows why the meeting was postponed.
ex.zh: 湯姆大概知道會議延期的原因。

ex.en: Their trip was postponed because of the rain.
ex.zh: 他們的旅行因為下雨延期了。

ex.en: Bob suggested postponing the party till Wednesday.
ex.zh: 鮑伯建議將聚會延後到週三。

ex.en: He pointed out how important it is to observe the law.
ex.zh: 他指出了遵守法律的重要性。

ex.en: The teacher pointed out your mistakes.
ex.zh: 老師指出了你的錯誤。

ex.en: Excuse me; allow me to point out three errors in the above article.
ex.zh: 抱歉，請允許我指出上文中的三個錯誤。

ex.en: Do you think he is good for the position?
ex.zh: 你認為他適合這個職位嗎？

ex.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
ex.zh: 這份職位要求應徵者有一定的英語口語表達能力。

ex.en: Many people get a job in customer services before they are qualified for other positions.
ex.zh: 許多人在有資格擔任其他職位之前，會先從客服工作做起。

ex.en: The soldiers retreated from their positions.
ex.zh: 士兵們撤離了陣地。

ex.en: I'm not in a position to make that decision.
ex.zh: 我沒有立場做這個決定。

ex.en: Designers usually bring a portfolio to the interview.
ex.zh: 設計師面試時通常會帶作品集。

ex.en: Her online portfolio shows her best photos.
ex.zh: 她的線上作品集展示了她最好的照片。

ex.en: It's wise to have a diverse investment portfolio.
ex.zh: 擁有多元的投資組合是明智的。

ex.en: He reviews his portfolio once a month.
ex.zh: 他每個月檢視一次自己的投資組合。
